premises.text: Existing installed remote/window/split air conditioners (~one billion units) are not smart/connected the way Nest-style thermostats are
premises.evidence_span: All I could find is smart thermostats like Nest. But I had this air conditioner in my home, and there are one billion of these kinds of air conditioners

premises.text: Sensible Pod attaches to any remote-control AC and uses app control plus learning algorithms to cut energy use (efficient temp, clogged filters, open windows, occupancy) without constant manual control
premises.evidence_span: we make any air conditioner smart

premises.text: Multiple ACs can be controlled from one place in the app
premises.evidence_span: You have like 10 rooms and 10 aces you want to control it from one place

premises.text: Basic kit is $160 plus $80 for each additional air conditioner
premises.evidence_span: The first kit, the basic kit for Sensible costs $160, and then for each additional air conditioner you have in your home or office, it's another $80

value.text: Large energy and electricity-bill savings on existing air conditioners with maintained comfort
value.evidence_span: we can actually save a huge amount of energy

secondary_value.text: Greener world via reduced CO2 emissions
secondary_value.evidence_span: we want the world to be greener to reduce co2 emissions

causal_links.evidence_span: the only logical conclusion was to build a product that connects to the air conditioner
save to our pilot users an average of 40% on the energy
we're taking pre-orders now on our site

notes: Nest gap and billion installed ACs folded as one retrofit need (§4.1.6). Efficient-temp, filter/window/occupancy detection, lifestyle learning, and multi-AC control folded as energy-smart pod cascade (§4.1.7–8). Wearable roadmap treated as future vision, not premise. Indiegogo awards excluded as traction. Anti-template: problem, product, and pricing separately revisable.
